Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: MauCAS (Mauritius Central Automated Switch) includes the MauCAS Instant Payment System (IPS), launched in August 2019 and operational with live transactions as of June 2024, enabling 24/7 instant account-to-account and QR payments across banks/PSPs nationwide ([AfricaNenda SIIPS MauCAS case study](https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/siips_2024_MauCas_CaseStudy_en.pdf)).

revision_notes: Confirmed and corroborated. The case study and the Bank of Mauritius's own MauCAS page (fetched) confirm the switch launched in August 2019 and operates nationwide 24/7 with mandatory participation of all 11 commercial banks plus a mobile money operator and two PSPs, supporting Fully deployed nationwide.
